title: Toronto Election Results
description: A unified, analysis-ready history of municipal, school board trustee, federal and provincial elections within the City of Toronto, from the last general elections before amalgamation (1993 federal, 1994 municipal, 1995 Ontario) through the 2026 municipal general election, with one row per candidacy and evidence-backed links that join each person's runs for office.
